claim: A routine made faster must be padded back to the original duration or the saving credited, or the game speeds up and pace moves with the work done.

evidence.text: The first sprite fast path made the game 14% fast in the simulator (7.41 frames an update against 8.59); the saving is added back to the wait (spr_credit).
Hooks that replace a plot rather than add to it need the plot's original time back in the wait, or pace still moves with the plot count.
A room at 28 MHz needs its original time back: a fit over all rooms, then a wait at the game's clock.
Pace wrapper: halt to the frame interrupt, then draw at 28 MHz inside the frame.
